$comment: Machine-readable reference for the page-report CLI: command surface and the exact shape of every --json output. Parse --json, never the human table.

global_flags.--server: server base URL; overrides PR_SERVER_URL and the config file

keys.server_url: server base URL, also settable via PR_SERVER_URL

config.token_env: PR_TOKEN overrides the stored credentials file

list.stdout: table: ID CREATED SIZE CREATED_BY TITLE

prune.duration_format: Go duration plus a d suffix, e.g. 30d, 720h, 90m

update.notes: --json applies with --check; refuses dev builds without --force

upload_constraints.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; frame-ancestors 'none'

errors.unauthenticated: no token, or it was revoked/deleted/expired; create a new one in the web dashboard and run page-report login
errors.credentials are from an older version th: stored file predates server-minted tokens; run page-report login
errors.stdin is not a terminal: login was run non-interactively; pipe the token with --token-stdin or set PR_TOKEN
errors.invalid server URL: must be an absolute http(s) URL
